input.quote: During the term of this Agreement, Company agrees to compensate Contractor as set forth in each Statement of Work.
input.rationale: The compensation provisions contain no most-favoured-nation or price-matching obligation in either direction, so nothing obliges Company to extend Contractor its best terms. Preferred position met (we note there is also no MFN in our favour, and that Contractor may change rates on 30 days' notice under 3(b), which is a pricing point rather than an MFN issue).

input.quote: Neither party shall, during the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year after its termination, solicit for hire as an employee, consultant or otherwise any of the other party's personnel who have had direct involvement with the Services, without such other party's express written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.
input.rationale: Sits at the fallback: mutual, limited to personnel with direct involvement in the Services, 12 months post-termination, and a solicitation (not no-hire) restriction with a consent path. The only shortfall against our preferred drafting is the absence of an express general-advertising / unsolicited-approach carve-out, which we note but do not redline.
